common_questions.question: Which reporters had the highest import value of a commodity in a year?
Who are a reporter's top partners in a year?
How did a reporter's trade value in a commodity change by year?
What is the net weight traded by each reporter in a year?
What flows exist between two countries?

coverage.reason: World rows are excluded by the population filter.
Nulls are present; sums ignore them.

description: Annual bilateral trade flows (UN Comtrade style) for 15 reporters over 2022-2024, covering three commodities: fertilizers (HS 31), crude petroleum oils (HS 2709) and electronic integrated circuits (HS 8542). Each row gives the trade value, quantity and weight of an import or export between a reporter and a partner. Partner rows include World total rows (partner code 0, ISO W00), which must be excluded when summing partners to avoid double counting. Answers questions on trade values by country, partner, commodity and year.

usage_notes: partneriso W00 (World) is a total of the country partners; exclude it when summing over partners, or filter to it alone for the reporter's total.
Each refyear is a separate observation; sum across years only for a multi-year total.
Imports are CIF and exports FOB; filter flowdesc rather than mixing the two.
qty has mixed units (kg, u, N/A); never sum it across qtyunitabbr values.
netwgt has nulls, so weight totals may be understated.

query_fixed.reason: With flow left out, imports and exports are summed together, which adds CIF and FOB values and double counts trade between reporters and partners. Flow is a qualifier, so it must be grouped by (and kept as an optional filter) rather than summed across. The description also wrongly says the parameters are required.

description.after: Annual bilateral trade flows (UN Comtrade style) for 15 reporters over 2022-2024, covering three commodities: fertilizers (HS 31), crude petroleum oils (HS 2709) and electronic integrated circuits (HS 8542). Each row gives the trade value, quantity and weight of an import or export between a reporter and a partner. Partner rows include World total rows (partner code 0, ISO W00), which must be excluded when summing partners to avoid double counting. Answers questions on trade values by country, partner, commodity and year.
